name: BMO Ascend World Elite Business Mastercard

localized_names.en: BMO Ascend World Elite Business Mastercard

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: Annual fee waived in the first year for the primary card and two employee cards.

credit_required.notes: Minimum $80,000 personal or $150,000 household income, $250,000 business revenue, or $400,000 in assets under management.

base_rate.description: 1.5 points per $1 on all other card purchases.

categories.label: Office supplies, and cellphone and internet bill payments

rewards.redemption_notes: Points redeem through the BMO Blue Rewards loyalty program.

signup_bonus.description: Up to 150,000 bonus points in the first year.

notes: Network tier is World Elite Mastercard per the card name.
